_comment: Claude Code MCP configuration — capability broker architecture.
Authority: environment/agents/adapters/claude-code/mcp.template.json is the
SINGLE canonical owner. The project-scope .mcp.json is RENDERED from this file
by ops/scripts/claude_projection.py (domain: mcp) and drift-checked — it is a
projection, never a second authority.
NO CREDENTIALS in this file or in the account environment. The broker holds
secrets on the far side of the trust boundary; this surface holds none.
Identity: there is NO platform-issued bearer env var for a hosted Claude Code
session. `CLAUDE_SESSION_JWT` was never an Anthropic primitive and is gone from
this file: it does not exist in the runtime, no code reads it, and a `.mcp.json`
header cannot carry the platform's per-session identity on the current contract
(cloud_default issues no broker-verifiable identity; see docs/DEGRADED_MODE_CONTRACT.md).
The broker verifies a session assertion ONLY where the platform projects one as
a file (CLAUDE_SESSION_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE on a self-hosted ccpool_* pool), read
by ops/secrets/capability_client.py — never a header interpolated here.
Credential-bearing capabilities (sonar.read_issues, semgrep.*, github.*,
context7.mcp, gitguardian.mcp) are therefore consumed through the capability
client CLI (`ops/secrets/capability_client.py --invoke <id>`), which attaches
the platform's file-based session assertion as the Authorization header.
They are deliberately NOT registered as .mcp.json servers here: a broker /mcp
route requires a verified identity that .mcp.json headers cannot supply, so
registering them would only ship dangling 401 references.
graphiti-memory is the one genuine MCP server: it points at the broker front
door (${L9_CAPABILITY_BROKER_URL}/mcp/graphiti) and carries NO bearer. The broker
resolves the Graphiti credential on its own side and authenticates the session
against its verifiable identity; initialize is anonymous but tools/list and
tools/call require that identity. When the broker URL is unset, the broker is not
deployed, or the platform issues no identity, this server returns an honest 401
and memory runs DEGRADED — the honest posture, not a reason to paste a token.
FORBIDDEN: GRAPHITI_MCP_TOKEN in server config, the retired HTTP l9-shared-memory
side door, and L9_MEMORY_HTTP_* lifecycle env.
